Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.model

Class SustainabilityScenario

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.model.SustainabilityScenario
public class SustainabilityScenario extends Object
Holds temporary household values for a sustainability scenario. These values are kept separate from the household's real resource records.
